response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), t AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(race_count) AS REAL) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM c) SELECT c.circuitId, c.race_count, c.race_count / t.total AS share, c.race_count / t.total - 1.0 / t.n AS margin_above_avg_share FROM c, t ORDER BY margin_above_avg_share DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average circuit's share is 1 / (number of circuits that have hosted at least one race), i.e. the mean of the per-circuit shares; circuits with no races in the races table are excluded.
Margin is the absolute difference in share (share minus average share), not a ratio or percentage relative to the average.
